18.1.prompt: Have enterprise size, complexity, industry, maturity, scope, permitted testing, contacts, remediation routing, or retrospective requirements changed the penetration-testing program?

18.2.prompt: Have external exposure, reconnaissance scope, tester qualifications, program requirements, or the last external test date changed?
18.2.followup_prompt: When was the most recent qualified external penetration test, and did it cover the current program scope and reconnaissance requirements?

18.3.prompt: Have penetration-test findings, impact, priorities, remediation deadlines, or effort decisions changed unresolved remediation?

18.4.prompt: Have new penetration tests, validation results, or decisions about necessary detection changes created outstanding validation or ruleset work?
18.4.followup_prompt: Which penetration tests have occurred since the prior assessment, and which still need security-measure validation or an explicit decision on detection changes?

18.5.prompt: Have internal networks, trust boundaries, program requirements, or the last internal test date changed internal penetration-testing coverage?
18.5.followup_prompt: When was the most recent internal penetration test, and which applicable program scope or requirements were omitted?
